description: Source code for the coredump logging backend in Zephyr RTOS, handling logging, error management, and shell commands related to coredump processing.

methods.name: coredump_logging_backend_start
methods.description: Initializes the logging backend, resets error state, processes logs, and signals start of coredump.

methods.name: coredump_logging_backend_end
methods.description: Finalizes the logging backend, logs errors if any, and signals end of coredump.

methods.name: coredump_logging_backend_buffer_output
methods.description: Outputs a buffer in hex format to the log, handling errors and buffer management.

methods.name: coredump_logging_backend_query
methods.description: Handles queries related to the backend, such as retrieving error status.

methods.name: coredump_logging_backend_cmd
methods.description: Executes commands for the backend, such as clearing errors.

methods.name: cmd_coredump_error_get
methods.description: Shell command to get current coredump error status.

methods.name: cmd_coredump_error_clear
methods.description: Shell command to clear coredump error status.
